anchor.required_bounded_repair: Restore the omitted drift-guard paragraph verbatim after both immutable five-field blocks without changing the fields.

one threshold-0.5 connected-component decoder per identity

gap.statement: The proposal is 1.410 points below READY. Structural drift and component sprawl are largely resolved; the remaining blockers are per-track crossing certification, seam and hidden-cycle numerics, trained-output pulse binding, and a control-path nonlinearity mismatch.

round_1_resolution.issue: degree-zero arc compression and missing closing-edge degree test
round_1_resolution.remainder: Per-track monotonic and no-hidden-cycle certification remains open.
Local-maximum semantics and exact tangent/resampler invariance remain open.

round_1_resolution.issue: integral decoder could replace final peak pass
round_1_resolution.remainder: The trained-response hard resolvability gate remains ambiguous.

round_1_resolution.issue: router controls retrained and latent cue bypass possible
round_1_resolution.remainder: A paired gate decision margin must be frozen.
The control averages logits before sigmoid while TempoRAC fuses sigmoid responses.
No implementation or data-bearing execution is authorized here.
The teacher prerequisite remains expensive to explain in four pages.

dominant_claim.claim: After a frozen response-unit prerequisite, identity-indexed cue-only local relative-tempo routing selects useful shared response scales under within-track drift.

strengths: fixed pose-only landmark and one-landmark-per-traversal origin average
closing-edge winding, coverage, circular-gap, collision, reconstruction, alias, and coherence tests
degree 0/-1/+2, harmonic, symmetry, static-code, decoder-bypass, homeomorphism, and resampler attacks
fail-closed natural-unit audit with no human-guided repair

blockers.issue: G1 permits up to 1% negative sequential edges at population level.
blockers.consequence: Net winding +1 can coexist with two forward seam crossings after backtracking; F7 counts both.
blockers.fix: For every target-emitting track require -1e-12 <= delta_t < 0.25 on every valid edge, no backward crossing, and exactly one positive crossing per retained-landmark traversal; otherwise abstain.

blockers.issue: F7 uses unspecified accumulation precision and raw floor seam ownership.
blockers.consequence: Near-integer accumulated phase can shift or duplicate a pulse across implementations.
blockers.fix: Use compensated float64 accumulation, S_tau with tau=1e-7 cycles, and pulse invariance for tau in {1e-8,1e-7,1e-6}; seam-ambiguous tracks abstain.

blockers.issue: Every edge with Delta q > 0 is valid, so source gaps do not operationally defend no hidden cycles.
blockers.consequence: A small wrapped endpoint increment cannot exclude unobserved full cycles across the gap.
blockers.fix: Freeze a supported acquisition domain, split unsupported gaps such as Delta q != 1, declare the minimum supported source period, and never unwrap, reconstruct, or decode across invalid gaps.

blockers.issue: The average of two normalized immediate-neighbor chords is called warp invariant.
blockers.consequence: On a curved orbit it depends on neighbor physical offsets and is only an approximate direction estimate under resampling.
blockers.fix: Relabel F1 and require full matched-state canonical-phase and emitted-pulse equality on unseen resamplers; remove the tangent from supported state or abstain if the gate fails.

blockers.issue: F5 says strict local maximum but specifies ell[t-1] < ell[t] >= ell[t+1].
blockers.consequence: Plateau and parabolic-denominator behavior is not deterministic.
blockers.fix: Freeze strict greater-than on both sides with negative denominator or an explicit plateau ownership/abstention rule.

degree_one_teacher.minimal_interface_fix: One evaluator-owned certify_target(track) predicate returning eligibility, abstention reason, landmarks, deltas, crossings, and pulse before any target is serialized.

one_final_peak_pass.decoder: One threshold-0.5 connected-component pass per supplied identity after positive NOLA.
positive_closures: no NMS, learned threshold, minimum distance, period rule, or integral fallback

blockers.issue: G4 does not say whether the held-out pulse pack contains operator fixtures, frozen trained-model outputs, or both.
blockers.fix: Use one schema with both sources; require zero hard threshold misses, extras, splits, and merges and record worst-case margins.

blockers.issue: G4 includes event spacings 2 and 3 despite the declared per-edge delta < 0.25 supported phase domain.
blockers.fix: Remove unsupported spacings 2 and 3; derive the minimum spacing and retain boundary cases from 4 upward.

one_final_peak_pass.failure_action: Reject strict TempoRAC; the integral audit remains non-decision-bearing.

strengths: local/global/uniform/blocked/shuffled interventions on the same cached response tensor
held-out expert-by-tempo diagonal matrix as supporting mechanism evidence

blocker.issue: TempoRAC mixes branch sigmoid probabilities, but the capacity control averages logits before one sigmoid.
blocker.consequence: A difference can arise from nonlinear placement and calibration rather than routing.
blocker.fix: Use identical sigmoid branches plus exact uniform probability-level fusion and name it an unrouted capacity-matched three-branch control.

cue_only_routing_and_matched_experts.decision_rule_fix: Replace bare G3 'beats' with a frozen paired lower-bound rule against the strongest nonlocal gate; blocked versus uniform is a path-integrity assertion.

gate_executability.closure: None at method level; implementation requires separate authorization.
Per-track crossing certificate, seam numerics, no-hidden-cycle rule, full resampler pulse equality, and strict landmark semantics.
Preserve raw-cue locality versus documented identity-local reference dependence.
Correct probability-level control fusion and freeze a paired decision threshold.
Bind operator and model-output packs, record hard margins, and remove unsupported spacings.
All earlier gates and evaluator/comparison hashes must pass before any run.

staged_compute_and_validation.qualification: Internal G/K checks are appropriate fail-closed receipts but should be compressed into three paper-visible evidence blocks.

dimensions_below_7.weakness: The schedule assumes unresolved G1/G4 numerical contracts can be settled during implementation, while feature-vault, execution JSON, fixtures, and traces are still specifications.
dimensions_below_7.concrete_fix: Freeze certify_target, supported gap/period assumptions, seam precision, strict landmark semantics, the corrected control, and the two-source G4 pack before any data-bearing run; budget 20-30 engineer-days under the same GPU cap.

dimensions_below_7.weakness: The central conjunction is unvalidated, closest-prior/TWCRAC overlap remains unresolved, eligible results do not exist, and the prerequisite can eclipse the routing claim in four pages.
dimensions_below_7.concrete_fix: Close the four contract edits, expose only three evidence blocks and one dominant claim, report teacher/decoder as eligibility, and keep novelty/title/server/result/paper authorization separate.

simplification_opportunities: Consolidate landmark, topology, crossing, gap, and seam rules into one certify_target interface and receipt.
Remove G4 spacings 2 and 3 because they lie outside the supported delta < 0.25 domain.
Reuse canonical sigmoid and uniform probability fusion for the unrouted capacity control.
Compress internal G/K receipts into three paper-visible evidence blocks without deleting fail-closed checks.

modernization_opportunities.reason: LLM, VLM, diffusion, RL, or inference-time search does not resolve phase topology, irregular sampling, response-scale selection, state isolation, or reconstruction semantics and would add sprawl.

drift.full_section_integrity_issue: Omitted trailing drift-guard paragraph must be restored verbatim in both copies.
future_drift_triggers: Replacing local three-expert routing with WARP-PHASE or an easier global selector
Using human evaluator fields to create, repair, or select training targets
Substituting an integral decoder after the fixed peak contract fails

remaining_action_items.action: Make response-unit certification per target-bearing track with strict forward increments and exactly one crossing per retained-landmark traversal.
Own seam and sampling numerics with compensated float64, S_tau, tolerance invariance, and an explicit no-hidden-cycle/source-gap rule.
Bind G4 to frozen held-out model outputs and operator fixtures, require hard zero split/merge/miss, and remove spacings 2 and 3.
Treat F1 as an approximate direction estimate, require full phase/pulse resampler equality, and freeze strict landmark semantics.
Move the capacity-control sigmoid before uniform probability fusion and freeze the paired G3 gate decision.
Keep one routing claim and three paper-visible evidence blocks; do not add modules or experiments.
Restore the omitted original drift-guard paragraph verbatim in both Problem Anchor occurrences without altering the five fields.
Keep novelty, closest-prior, title, implementation, server/training, result, paper, and submission authorization separate.

verdict.rationale: The revised proposal is on-anchor and focused, but individual one-event certification, seam and hidden-cycle numerics, trained-response peak binding, and exact capacity-control matching remain blocking.
